lines.en: label yasuspring5:
scene sky
: Now? But what if he’s busy?
lines.zh: : 现在吗？可要是他在忙呢？

lines.en: : Then I’ll make him {i}not{/i} busy. I’m rich. I can do that.
lines.zh: : 那我就让他{i}不{/i}忙。我有钱。我办得到。

lines.en: : Wow! Being rich sounds very fun. And there’s no one more deserving of that than you, Touka.
lines.zh: : 哇！有钱听起来真好玩。而且没有谁比你更配拥有这些了，Touka。

lines.en: : Oh, Yasu — you flatter me. Please hold on for one moment.
lines.zh: : 哦，Yasu——你太抬举我了。请稍等片刻。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame1
: Hello?
: {i}Good evening, Sensei. How are-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}晚上好，Sensei。你最近——{/i}

lines.en: : What even {i}is{/i} evening?
lines.zh: : 「晚上」{i}到底是{/i}个什么玩意儿？

lines.en: : {i}I’m sorry?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你说什么？{/i}

lines.en: : When does it start? When does it end? It’s not afternoon. It’s not night. And doesn’t afternoon eventually {i}become{/i} night? So what room does that leave for evening to exist? {i}Does{/i} it even exist at all?
lines.zh: : 它什么时候开始？什么时候结束？它不是下午，也不是夜里。而下午不是迟早会{i}变成{/i}夜里吗？那还剩下什么空间给「晚上」存在？它{i}到底{/i}存不存在？

lines.en: : {i}Um...I...I haven’t really thought about...that before.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}呃……我……我还真没……想过这个。{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s why I’m a visionary and you’re not.
lines.zh: : 是啊。所以我才是幻想家，而你不是。

lines.en: : {i}I don’t think you’re a visionary, just that you have visions. Which actually allows me to segue into the reason for my call!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我不觉得你是幻想家，只觉得你有幻觉。不过这正好让我能顺势切入我打这通电话的原因！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are you busy right now? I need your help turning Yasu back into Yasu.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你现在忙吗？我需要你帮忙把 Yasu 变回 Yasu。{/i}

lines.en: : What is she right now?
lines.zh: : 那她现在是什么？

lines.en: : {i}Yasu, of course.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}当然是 Yasu 啊。{/i}

lines.en: : Great. Then my job here is done.
lines.zh: : 很好。那我的活儿干完了。

lines.en: : {i}You will obey me or I will strip you of the apartment I gifted to you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你会服从我的，不然我就收回我送你的那套公寓。{/i}

lines.en: : Go ahead. I barely use that place anyway.
lines.zh: : 随便。反正我很少去那儿。

lines.en: : {i}I’ll let you grope one of my breasts for ten seconds.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我让你摸我一边胸，摸十秒。{/i}

lines.en: scene black
: Sorry, where are we meeting?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我们在哪儿碰头？

lines.en: : {i}Is such a lascivious gesture truly worth more to you than free shelter?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}这种淫秽的举动，对你来说真的比免费住所还值钱？{/i}

lines.en: : Where. Are. We-
lines.zh: : 在哪儿。我们——

lines.en: : {i}The cathedral! We’re about to head over now. That won’t be a problem, will it?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大教堂！我们现在就过去。没问题吧？{/i}

lines.en: : Not for you. You don’t need to run there with an erection.
lines.zh: : 对你来说没问题。你又不用硬着跑过去。

lines.en: : {i}Splendid! See you soon, then!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}妙极了！那就待会儿见！{/i}

lines.en: I hang up the phone and immediately begin to make my way over to the seedy area of Kumon-mi where Yasu’s church is located.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，立刻动身前往 Kumon-mi 那个 Yasu 教堂所在的破落街区。

lines.en: scene urbanparadise
The soundtrack then immediately changes upon my arrival because joy does not exist here and because I remember why I was summoned in the first place.
lines.zh: 我一到，背景音乐立刻就换了——因为这里不存在欢乐，也因为我想起了自己到底为什么被叫来。

lines.en: To make a girl feel more like a girl like a girl to make her feel girl to make it.
lines.zh: 去让一个女孩更像女孩，像女孩那样，去让她有女孩的感觉，去把它做出来。

lines.en: scene black
I should probably go dooooooo that.
lines.zh: 我大概该去干那件——事——了。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame2
: Hello, Sensei! Thank you for returning to these hallowed halls — the chamber in which lambs aren’t sent to slaughter, but laughter! Haha! It’s a joke!
lines.zh: : 你好，Sensei！感谢你回到这神圣的殿堂——这间羔羊不是被送去屠宰、而是送去欢笑的厅堂！哈哈！这是个玩笑！

lines.en: : Hi. I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 嗨。我没听懂。

lines.en: : Just humor her, please. But yes, thank you for coming.
lines.zh: : 顺着她就行了，拜托。不过，是的，谢谢你来。

lines.en: : No problem. Do I get my reward now or later?
lines.zh: : 不客气。我的奖励现在给还是待会儿给？

lines.en: : Hm? What reward?
lines.zh: : 嗯？什么奖励？

lines.en: : You fucking-
lines.zh: : 你他——

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame3
: {b}{size=+15}NO SWEARING IN CHURCH!!!!!{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: : {b}{size=+15}教堂里不准说脏话！！！！！{/size}{/b}

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame4
: Today, we’re going to play a game! It’s one I used to play with the rabbits — and the idea is to find out what color your light is.
lines.zh: : 今天，我们要玩一个游戏！我以前跟兔子们玩的游戏——目的是查出你的光是什么颜色。

lines.en: : All you have to do is answer a series of questions as truthfully as you can so I can consult with the Book of Colors about what color {i}you{/i} are! It’s another joke! Hahah!
lines.zh: : 你只要尽可能诚实地回答一系列问题，我就能去查《色彩之书》，看看{i}你{/i}是什么颜色！这又是个玩笑！哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame5
: Correct me if I’m wrong here, but didn’t you say something about Yasu not being {i}Yasu{/i} when we were on the phone? Because she seems very {i}Yasu{/i} to me right now.
lines.zh: : 我说错了我更正一下，我们在电话里的时候，你不是说过 {i}Yasu{/i} 变得不像 Yasu 了吗？因为现在在我看来她非常 {i}Yasu{/i}。

lines.en: : I assure you this is more surprising to me than it is to you. I’ve been with her all day and it wasn’t until you arrived that she started acting...{i}normal{/i} again.
lines.zh: : 我向你保证，我比你更惊讶。我陪了她一整天，直到你来了，她才开始……恢复{i}正常{/i}。

lines.en: : HehhehehahahahahahahAHAHA! You knew it would work, Touka! You’re so smart and wonderful! And Sensei! You are so {i}bright.{/i} It’s like you haven’t grown a day!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿嘿嘿哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈HAHA！你知道会管用的，Touka！你又聪明又了不起！还有 Sensei！你好{i}耀眼{/i}。就像你一点都没长大过！

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame6
: Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : {i}Just be nice and play along. She’s undergone a long and arduous medicinal journey as of late and I see this as giving her a chance to play around in the sandbox for an hour or two.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}好好说话，顺着她就行。她最近经历了一段漫长而艰辛的用药旅程，我把它看作给她一个在沙坑里玩上一两个小时的机会。{/i}

lines.en: : Okay...but if things go south, you can’t blame me for it. Places like this don’t really mix with the masses of strange misshapen gods appearing to me on a weekly basis now.
lines.zh: : 好吧……不过要是情况变糟，你可不能怪我。这种地方，跟我每周都会见到的那些奇形怪状的神明实在不太对付。

lines.en: : The what?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame7
: Remember! Honestly and truthfully! Just think about what Wormwood says — lie about your light and you’ll lie alone at night! Do both of you understand?
lines.zh: : 记住！诚实、如实！想想 Wormwood 怎么说的——对自己的光撒谎，夜里就会独自躺着撒谎！你们两个都明白了吗？

lines.en: : Poor Niki. I wonder what will happen to her.
lines.zh: : 可怜的 Niki。我好奇她会怎么样。

lines.en: : Hopefully nothing as dramatic as you. Please continue, Yasu.
lines.zh: : 希望别像你这么戏剧化。请继续，Yasu。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame8
: Hahahehehah! Okay! This is going to be so much fun!
lines.zh: : 哈哈嘿嘿哈！好！这一定会非常有趣！

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame9
: Question one! What would you do with three plates of squid?
lines.zh: : 第一题！你会拿三盘鱿鱼怎么办？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame10
: Um...in what context, may I ask?
lines.zh: : 呃……请问是在什么情境下？

lines.en: : Are the squid...prepared? Are they alive?
lines.zh: : 那些鱿鱼……是做好的吗？还是活的？

lines.en: : They are whatever you want them to be! There is no right or wrong answer, Touka! Just believe in yourself and say whatever it is you {i}want{/i} to say! It’s a {i}game,{/i} remember?
lines.zh: : 你{i}想{/i}让它们是什么，它们就是什么！没有对错答案，Touka！只要相信自己，想说什么就说什么！这是{i}游戏{/i}，记得吗？

lines.en: : I...suppose that is true. But if I could have a moment to ponder over the potential answers, I-
lines.zh: : 我……想也是。不过要是能给我一点时间斟酌一下可能的答案，我——

lines.en: : Three plates of squid. Three plates of squid. What would you do with three plates of squid?
lines.zh: : 三盘鱿鱼。三盘鱿鱼。你会拿三盘鱿鱼怎么办？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame10r
: As I was saying, I’m attempting to formulate an answer. But it requires more than-
lines.zh: : 正如我刚才说的，我在试着组织一个答案。但这需要的可不止——

lines.en: : Would you eat ‘em all up? Cut ‘em up nice? Dice ‘em in pieces and feed ‘em to mice?
lines.zh: : 你会把它们全吃光？把它们切得细细的？剁成小块喂给老鼠？

lines.en: : Can mice even-
lines.zh: : 老鼠能吃——

lines.en: : Three plates of squid. Three plates of squid. Death isn’t real and joy they forbid.
lines.zh: : 三盘鱿鱼。三盘鱿鱼。死亡并不真实，而欢乐他们禁止。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame11
: Is this...some sort of strange nursery rhyme they tell to commoners?
lines.zh: : 这是……他们讲给平民听的某种奇怪童谣吗？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame12
: I...don’t know. I just...wanted to say all of that for...some reason.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道。我只是……想把这些话全说出来，出于……某种原因。

lines.en: : Your answer has been recorded! Touka?
lines.zh: : 你的答案已记录！Touka？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame13
: I would distribute them amongst the needy.
lines.zh: : 我会把它们分给需要的人。

lines.en: : Yay! Now {i}your{/i} answer has been recorded!
lines.zh: : 耶！现在{i}你的{/i}答案也记录了！

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame14
: Question two — what is love?
lines.zh: : 第二题——爱是什么？

lines.en: : The most beautiful thing in the world — shared traditionally between a man and woman, but also between all sorts of other people as I have recently learned. Which {i}I{/i} think is wonderful.
lines.zh: : 世上最美好的东西——传统上由一男一女共享，但正如我最近了解到的，也可以存在于各种其他人之间。{i}我{/i}觉得这很美好。

lines.en: : Blind...
lines.zh: : 盲目的……

lines.en: : Typical. My answer was better.
lines.zh: : 老套。我的答案更好。

lines.en: : Your answers have been recorded!
lines.zh: : 你们的答案已记录！

lines.en: : Question three — which coffee machine is the arch nemesis of the Hario v60?
lines.zh: : 第三题——Hario v60 的死对头是哪台咖啡器具？

lines.en: : Now what does that even-
lines.zh: : 这又是什么——

lines.en: : The Kalita Wave. Keep going.
lines.zh: : Kalita Wave。继续。

lines.en: : What is a {i}Kalita Wave?{/i} What is a {i}Hario v60?{/i} How did you come up with an answer so quickly and why does Yasu’s color game involve questions about coffee machines?
lines.zh: : 什么是 {i}Kalita Wave{/i}？什么是 {i}Hario v60{/i}？你怎么这么快就想出答案，还有为什么 Yasu 的颜色游戏里会有咖啡器具的问题？

lines.en: : I don’t know...but I know the answers.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……但我知道答案。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i} There {i}are{/i} no right or wrong answers, Sensei. Even Yasu says-
lines.zh: : {i}咳咳{/i}。{i}没有{/i}对错答案，Sensei。Yasu 自己也说过——

lines.en: : {b}ANSWER THE QUESTION, TOUKA!{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}回答问题，TOUKA！{/b}

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame15
: It’s important that we don’t keep the Book of Colors waiting.
lines.zh: : 我们不能让《色彩之书》等着，这很重要。

lines.en: : I...concur with Sensei’s assessment that the “Kalita Wave” is the arch nemesis of the-
lines.zh: : 我……同意 Sensei 的判断，「Kalita Wave」是它的死对头——

lines.en: : Question four — who said there is nothing to fear but fear itself?
lines.zh: : 第四题——谁说过「除了恐惧本身，没有什么可恐惧的」？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame16
: Franklin Delano Roosevelt! I know this one! Ha! That means there {i}are{/i} right and wrong answers! I’ve been deceived!
lines.zh: : Franklin Delano Roosevelt！这个我知道！哈！这说明{i}有{/i}对错答案！我被骗了！

lines.en: : ...yeah. My answer is the same.
lines.zh: : ……是啊。我的答案也一样。

lines.en: : Your answers have been recorded! Question five — breathing the right way? How to do? How many? Only two!
lines.zh: : 你们的答案已记录！第五题——正确的呼吸方式？怎么做？多少次？只有两次！

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame17
: That one doesn’t even make any sense! I hate this game! How could someone possibly-
lines.zh: : 这一题根本不通！我讨厌这个游戏！怎么会有人——

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame18
: You know...
lines.zh: : 你知道吗……

lines.en: : Perhaps there...{i}is{/i} some sort of link between the two of you. Because, whether it be conscious or not, you’re hardly even hesitating with these. And Yasu seems far more pleased with {i}your{/i} answers than mine.
lines.zh: : 也许你们两个之间……{i}真有{/i}某种联系。因为不管是不是有意为之，你答这些题几乎没有迟疑。而 Yasu 对{i}你的{/i}答案显然比对我的满意得多。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame19
: He’s doing an excellent job, I think! But it’s not the answers themselves that matter most, dearest Touka! It’s the confidence with which one says them.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他做得非常出色！不过最要紧的不是答案本身，亲爱的 Touka！而是说出答案时的自信。

lines.en: : Then {i}I{/i} am going to say {i}19.{/i} That way, there is a 50%% chance that my answer is closer if Sensei is wrong. Which I know is possible because of FDR.
lines.zh: : 那{i}我{/i}就说 {i}19{/i}。这样一来，要是 Sensei 错了，我的答案有 50% 的概率更接近。我知道这是有可能的，因为 FDR 那题。

lines.en: : Your answer has been recorded. There are only six thousand, nine hundred, seventy-four questions to go until we figure out what color your light is.
lines.zh: : 你的答案已记录。距离查出你们的光是什么颜色，还剩六千九百七十四道题。

lines.en: : Yasu...can you show me that clipboard?
lines.zh: : Yasu……能给我看看那块记录板吗？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame20

lines.zh: : 为什么？……

lines.en: : Do you not {i}trust{/i} me, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 你不{i}信任{/i}我吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : It’s less that I don’t trust you and more that I just...want to know why the answers to all of these are immediately coming to me.
lines.zh: : 与其说我不信任你，不如说我只想……知道为什么这些答案会立刻冒出来。

lines.en: : Perhaps you played this same sort of game when {i}you{/i} were younger? It’s true that you can’t recall much about your past, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 也许{i}你{/i}小时候玩过同样的游戏？你确实记不起太多过去的事，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...maybe. This wouldn’t be the first time Yasu just...knew things about my past for some reason. Which is why I want to see what she’s holding.
lines.zh: : 是啊……也许吧。这也不是 Yasu 第一次不知为什么就……知道我过去的事。所以我想看看她手里拿着什么。

lines.en: : That’s not how the game works, unfortunately. {i}I{/i} ask the questions. {i}You{/i} answer them. Then {i}we{/i} find out what color your light is {i}together.{/i}
lines.zh: : 可惜游戏不是这么玩的。{i}我{/i}来问，{i}你们{/i}来答。然后{i}我们{/i}{i}一起{/i}查出你们的光是什么颜色。

lines.en: : If you see the questions beforehand, you’ll have time to think of answers. If you have time to think of answers, you won’t answer honestly. Do you {i}want{/i} to be red? Because it sounds like you want to be red.
lines.zh: : 要是你事先看到题目，你就有时间编答案。有时间编答案，你就不会诚实作答。你{i}想{/i}变成红色吗？因为听起来你就是想变成红色。

lines.en: : Is there a problem with red, Yasu?
lines.zh: : 红色有什么问题吗，Yasu？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame21
: Yes! Red is bad! Those who are coated in the prism’s blood shall not find peace in their departure from this plane! Have you not been listening to me?! I say it all the time!
lines.zh: : 有！红色很糟！被棱镜之血涂满的人，离开这个位面时不会得到安宁！你没在听我说话吗？！我可是天天都在说！

lines.en: : Yasu...please calm down. Remember what we talked about earlier, okay? You can say whatever you like here, but getting carried away can still be dangerous. And you don’t want to upset Sensei.
lines.zh: : Yasu……请冷静一下。记得我们之前说过的，好吗？在这里你想说什么都行，但忘乎所以依然可能危险。而且你也不想让 Sensei 难受。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame22
: {i}Hooooohhhh......{/i}
: Gooooood...
: In...then out....
lines.zh: : 吸——气——然后呼——气……

lines.en: : Just like that...
lines.zh: : 就是这样……

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame23
scene yasuchurchgame24
scene yasuchurchgame25
scene yasuchurchgame26
: Um...maybe...{i}not{/i} like that.
lines.zh: : 呃……也许……{i}别{/i}那样。

lines.en: : Hah...haah...hah!...
: Why are the rabbits here, Yasu? Which ones...are they?
lines.zh: : 那些兔子为什么在这里，Yasu？它们……是哪几只？

lines.en: : Hah...hah...Penemue...and...Etinsib Ziwa...
lines.zh: : 哈……哈……Penemue……还有……Etinsib Ziwa……

lines.en: : I haven’t met that one before, have I?
lines.zh: : 这一只我之前没见过吧？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame27
: You’ve been keeping track of their names?
lines.zh: : 你一直在记它们的名字？

lines.en: : I’m weirdly good at remembering stuff like that.
lines.zh: : 我记这种东西意外地擅长。

lines.en: : That’s strange because you’re utterly horrible at remembering effectively everything else.
lines.zh: : 奇怪了，因为其他所有事你都记得一塌糊涂。

lines.en: : Hah...hah...no...you have not met...
lines.zh: : 哈……哈……不……你没有见过……

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame28
: At least...not the you...currently {i}inhabiting...{/i}you....
lines.zh: : 至少……现在{i}住在{/i}你里面的那个「你」……没有……

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame29
: But he was looking forward to this day...for he knew someone that {i}you{/i} knew...but he dare not speak their name.
lines.zh: : 但他一直盼着这一天……因为他认识一个{i}你{/i}认识的人……可他不敢说出那个名字。

lines.en: : Well, I guess that all but confirms that connection I mentioned moments ago.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我想这基本证实了我刚才提到的那种联系。

lines.en: : Can {i}you{/i} speak their name, Yasu?
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}能说出那个名字吗，Yasu？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame30

: I’m afraid I don’t know it. I am but a broken-winged fledgling compared to the rabbits and their aeons worth of knowledge. All I can do is deliver the messages small enough to fit in the clutches of my intangible talons.
lines.zh: : 恐怕我不知道。跟兔子们和它们那以永劫计的知识相比，我不过是一只断了翅膀的雏鸟。我能做的，只是传递那些小到能让我这双无形的爪子抓住的信息。

lines.en: : But even if I {i}did{/i} know...I’m not sure I could tell you.
lines.zh: : 但就算我{i}知道{/i}……我也不确定能不能告诉你。

lines.en: : It’s not part of the game.
lines.zh: : 那不是游戏的一部分。

lines.en: : And will we be getting back to this “game” any time soon? Because it feels as if we’ve gotten rather sidetracked between the yelling and...{i}breathing.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那我们还要不要回到这个「游戏」上？感觉我们在吼叫和……{i}呼吸{/i}之间，已经跑题跑得够远了。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame31
: Yes! Yes...you’re right. That’s...why we’re here. I must stay...focused on the task at hand and...maintain this...newly discovered...free will...
lines.zh: : 要！是的……你说得对。这才是……我们来这儿的目的。我必须……专注于手头的事，维持住这份……新发现的……自由意志……

lines.en: : Question...
: Question six...
lines.zh: : 第六题……

lines.en: : If the world were to start anew...and you could only take one soul with you...
lines.zh: : 如果世界重新开始……而你只能带走一个灵魂……

lines.en: : Who would it be?...
lines.zh: : 你会带谁？……

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame32
: This is significantly more bleak than the rest of your questions thus far. Is such an answer really necessary to decipher our color?
lines.zh: : 这比你前面那些问题阴郁多了。要解读我们的颜色，真的需要这种答案吗？

lines.en: : This question is special...it provides a fast track to a somewhat accurate result for those who don’t mind skipping the rest of the quiz.
lines.zh: : 这题很特别……它为那些不介意跳过其余题目的人，提供了一条通往还算准确结果的捷径。

lines.en: : Oh, excellent. I can’t imagine either one of us wants to stick around for thousands more of these.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。我想我们俩都不想再耗上几千道题。

lines.en: : I suppose I’ll just say my mother. I care deeply for her and still have much left to learn.
lines.zh: : 我就说我母亲吧。我很在乎她，而且还有很多要跟她学的。

lines.en: : Wow, thanks.
lines.zh: : 哇，谢了啊。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame33
: What? You didn’t really think I’d choose {i}you,{/i} did you?
lines.zh: : 什么？你该不会真以为我会选{i}你{/i}吧？

lines.en: : Good luck starting civilization all over with your mom. At least you and I could reproduce.
lines.zh: : 祝你跟你妈从头开创文明顺利。至少你跟我还能繁衍后代。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame34
: Oh my.
lines.zh: : 哎呀。

lines.en: : I’ll take Ami. I owe it to her.
lines.zh: : 我选 Ami。我欠她的。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame35
: Even after bringing up reproduction?!
lines.zh: : 在你说完繁衍之后还说这个？！

lines.en: : Fine, I’ll just copy your answer and take your mom too then.
lines.zh: : 好，那我就照抄你的答案，也带你妈走。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame36
: Aaaah! I hate this stupid game! No offense, Yasu! It’s been very fun and I hope you were able to effectively communicate with your god again!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！我讨厌这个蠢游戏！没有冒犯的意思，Yasu！真的很好玩，希望你能顺利跟你的神重新通上话！

lines.en: : Thank you, Touka. I’m sorry if you hated it. I {i}did{/i} have a lot of fun, though! But unfortunately, I didn’t hear as much as I wanted to...
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Touka。如果你不喜欢，我很抱歉。不过我{i}玩得很开心{/i}！只是可惜，我听到的没有我想的那么多……

lines.en: : Either way! Give me a minute to look up your results in the Book of Colors!
lines.zh: : 不管怎样！给我一分钟，我去《色彩之书》里查你们的结果！

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame37
: Has she ever brought up this “Book of Colors” thing to you before?
lines.zh: : 她以前跟你提过这本「色彩之书」吗？

lines.en: : Unlike you, I have quite a difficult time keeping track of all of this spiritual nonsense. It’s possible she has, I assume. But it’s not as if I specifically remember it.
lines.zh: : 不像你，我很难记住这些灵性方面的胡话。我想她可能提过。但我不记得有印象。

lines.en: : What do you think is in there?
lines.zh: : 你觉得里面有什么？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame38
: Over six thousand more personality quiz questions, at the very least.
lines.zh: : 至少还有六千多道性格测试题。

lines.en: : Seriously, though. Aren’t you at least a {i}little{/i} interested?
lines.zh: : 说真的。你就{i}一点{/i}都不好奇吗？

lines.en: : Not as much as you, it seems. But {i}I’m{/i} not the one with deep-seated memories of any of this. If they really are just memories and {i}you{/i} can’t apparently hear things too.
lines.zh: : 显然没{i}你{/i}好奇。但{i}我{/i}可没有关于这些的深层记忆。如果它们真的只是记忆——而你显然也听不见东西的话。

lines.en: : I used to.
lines.zh: : 我以前能听见。

lines.en: : Oh, fantastic.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。

lines.en: : Not so much anymore, though.
lines.zh: : 不过现在不太行了。

lines.en: : Oh, fantastic. But for real this time.
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。不过这次是真心的。

lines.en: : I’m just saying...maybe Yasu isn’t as crazy as everyone makes her out to be? Maybe we {i}should{/i} let her ramble on and...be mean if she wants to. Maybe we’ll learn something?
lines.zh: : 我只是说……也许 Yasu 没大家说得那么疯？也许我们{i}该{/i}由着她啰嗦下去……想刻薄就刻薄。也许我们能学到点什么？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame39

: {i}That was my intention!{/i} That’s why I called you here! There’s just something deeply unsettling to me whenever I see that adorably pathetic girl begin to slip away and be replaced by...some kind of demon!
lines.zh: : {i}我就是这个意思！{/i}所以我才叫你来！只是每次看到那个可爱又可悲的女孩开始从我眼前溜走、被……某种恶魔取代时，我都会感到深深的不安！

lines.en: : I’m a demon like 99%% of the time and you still willingly talk to me.
lines.zh: : 我 99% 的时间都是个恶魔，你还是照样愿意跟我说话。

lines.en: : Yes, but {i}you{/i} don’t giggle when I brush your hair or ask to sleep in my bed during thunderstorms.
lines.zh: : 是，但{i}你{/i}不会在我给你梳头的时候咯咯笑，也不会在打雷时要求睡我床上。

lines.en: : I’m naturally protective of Yasu. Like an {i}actual{/i} mother. Not the fetishistic type {i}you{/i} see me as. I shan’t be blamed for becoming uncomfortable watching the poor girl get aroused by {i}deep breathing.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我天生就想护着 Yasu。像个{i}真正{/i}的母亲那样。不是{i}你{/i}把我当成那种有恋母癖的人。看着那可怜的女孩被{i}深呼吸{/i}搞得起反应，我变得不舒服，这总不能怪我吧。

lines.en: : In her defense, you {i}did{/i} make it sound kind of sexual.
lines.zh: : 替她说句公道话，你{i}确实{/i}把它说得有点色情。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame40
: Not purposely! Why does everything with you always have to have some sort of inappropriate undertone?!
lines.zh: : 不是故意的！为什么什么事到了你那儿都得沾点下流的意味？！

lines.en: : {i}That’s{/i} not purposeful either. It’s just the way I think. And Yasu clearly has her own distinctive way of thinking too. So don’t you think it might be beneficial to just...let her go off and see what happens?
lines.zh: : {i}那{/i}也不是故意的。我就是这么思考的。而 Yasu 显然也有她自己独特的思考方式。所以你不觉得……放她去说、看看会发生什么，也许会有好处吗？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame41
: Perhaps you’re right...
lines.zh: : 也许你是对的……

lines.en: : I just worry that some of her beliefs are a bit too...unconventional to justify indulging her. But I suppose that this {i}is{/i} the safest sort of environment we can cultivate for her at the end of the-
lines.zh: : 我只是担心，她的某些信念有点太……不合常理，不该由着她。但我想，这{i}已经{/i}是我们能为她营造的最安全的环境了，在这——

lines.en: : I have received your results from the Book of Colors...
lines.zh: : 我从《色彩之书》里收到你们的结果了……

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame42
: I have received your results from the Book of Colors!
lines.zh: : 我从《色彩之书》里收到你们的结果了！

lines.en: : And great news! You’re not red! You can still ascend! There’s still hope left for both of you!
lines.zh: : 好消息！你们不是红色！你们还能升天！你们两个都还有希望！

lines.en: : H...Hooraaaay! Is there...anything we must do next? Or is the game just...over now?
lines.zh: : 万……万岁！还有……什么是我们必须做的吗？还是游戏就……这么结束了？

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame43
: There is one more thing! But I don’t want to make you stay here if you are bored and tired of my existence. Both of you are free to leave me here to rot instead if that is what you prefer!
lines.zh: : 还有一件事！不过要是你们已经厌烦、厌倦了我的存在，我不想强留你们。你们两个也可以把我留在这儿烂掉，如果那样更合你们意！

lines.en: : No, Yasu. We will not leave you here to {i}rot.{/i} Just tell us what the next step is and we’ll happily oblige.
lines.zh: : 不，Yasu。我们不会把你留在这儿{i}烂掉{/i}。告诉我们下一步是什么，我们很乐意照做。

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame44
: The next step is to make sure your color doesn’t change!
lines.zh: : 下一步是——确保你们的颜色不变！

lines.en: : In this world of infinite possibilities, it is easier than ever to be tainted by misdeeds and temptation! But if you take a vow of loyalty, you can prevent their untimely onset!
lines.zh: : 在这个充满无限可能的世界里，被恶行与诱惑玷污比以往任何时候都容易！但只要你立下忠诚的誓言，就能阻止它们过早降临！

lines.en: : {i}Hah.{/i} Okay. I, Touka Tsukioka, hereby swear to remain loyal to-
lines.zh: : {i}哈{/i}。好。我，Touka Tsukioka，在此宣誓忠于——

lines.en: scene yasuchurchgame45
: Not here, Touka! No! We have to go somewhere else!
lines.zh: : 不是在这里，Touka！不行！我们得去别的地方！

lines.en: : Y...Yasu. We need to remain here. Exercising your “free will” outside of this place is-
lines.zh: : Y……Yasu。我们需要留在这里。在这个地方之外行使你的「自由意志」是——

lines.en: : It {i}is{/i} here, Touka! It is!
lines.zh: : {i}就在{/i}这里，Touka！就在！

lines.en: scene black
: Just follow me! I’ll show you! It’s amazing! The most amazing thing you’ll ever see!
lines.zh: : 跟我来就行！我带你们去看！太不可思议了！你们从没见过这么不可思议的东西！

lines.en: : O-Oh! Okay. I...I suppose we’re...relocating then, Sensei. A-After you.
lines.zh: : 噢——哦！好。我……我想我们……要转移阵地了，Sensei。你——你先请。

lines.en: : You’re not scared, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是害怕了吧？

lines.en: : Me? Scared?! Ha! No! Nuh-uh! I just...think that you should go first since you’re the tallest.
lines.zh: : 我？害怕？！哈！不！才没有！我只是……觉得你该走前面，因为你最高。

lines.en: : We’ll all go together! Come on, come on, come on!
lines.zh: : 我们一起走！来吧，来吧，来吧！

lines.en: $ yasuspring5 = True
$ yasu_love += 1
$ touka_love += 1
jump toukaspring4
